sentences.text: Required portable fire extinguishers depend on boat length.
Under twenty-six feet, you need one B-one extinguisher.
From twenty-six to under forty feet, two B-ones or one B-two.
From forty to sixty-five feet, three B-ones, or one B-two plus one B-one.
An approved fixed system in the engine room reduces the requirement by one B-one.
Newer extinguishers are labeled five-B and twenty-B instead of B-one and B-two, and boats built in recent years must carry those.
Disposable extinguishers must be replaced twelve years after their date of manufacture.
Mount them where you can reach them quickly, and check the gauges.
